panel_seams: GLB has a single continuous corpus1 shell with no panel IDs. Door and bumper seams are estimated from Taycan proportions; wheel centres are hard datums.

left.notes: Wheel ellipses include about 12 px clearance around the full visible discs and tyres. Glazing is intentionally included as a wrap surface; lamps and plate remain structural exclusions. Side photo is 1673x485.

right.notes: Wheel ellipses include about 12 px clearance around the full visible discs and tyres. Glazing is intentionally included as a wrap surface; lamps and plate remain structural exclusions. Side photo is 2072x600.

hood.notes: Windshield is excluded by the hood/bumper surface envelope; photo is 1337x884.

rear.notes: Lamp bar remains cut out except bright client PORSCHE lettering at x=390..900, y=282..326. Grille starts below the printed Unit-00/warning band; rear photo is 1291x891.
